text:
nora: Quick ask: HarvestCo wants a 4-week on-prem POC in a processing plant. Must be air-gapped (no network egress), physical media only, customer-provided HSM (YubiHSM2), quarterly patch windows, signed SBOM + chain-of-custody. They need feasibility, offline activation flow, and a ballpark POC quote.
kevin: Confirming: they bring the HSM and an operator workstation inside the perimeter? Also: any requirement for FIPS?
nora: They will provide YubiHSM2 and an operator box. FIPS not mandated now but might be requested later.
sophie: From runtime: we support PKCS#11 userland integration. We can provide a detached sig-request workflow and installer verification using the Yubi client lib. No kernel modules needed.
kevin: Two signing patterns: (1) customer-sign with YubiHSM (preferred) where they keep keys; (2) Redwood-sign + customer verification. For air-gap, customer-sign meets control needs.
sophie: Offline activation notes: rdwctl can generate a manifest and sig-request; operator signs on the air-gapped workstation and returns sig.bin on USB. Installer verifies before apply. Example (concept):
```
rdwctl bundle create --model quant-7b --out bundle.tar.gz --manifest manifest.json
rdwctl sig-request --manifest manifest.json > sigreq.bin
# operator signs on airgapped workstation
hsm-sign --lib /usr/lib/libyubihsm.so --key rdw-sign sigreq.bin > sig.bin
rdwctl verify --manifest manifest.json --sig sig.bin --pkcs11 /usr/lib/libyubihsm.so
```
eng-bot: Created ticket RDW-9020: "HarvestCo airgap POC - YubiHSM signing & courier" assigned to @sophie. https://redwood.example/tickets/RDW-9020
kevin: Logistics: recommend quantized artifacts to keep courier sizes small. Typical delta ~100-800MB. For POC quote: Private license + 2-4 eng days for onboarding + courier costs. I'll draft numbers and attach to ticket.
sophie: Security bits: telemetry disabled by default for Private installs; we can provide signed SBOM and attestations. For emergency hotfixes we support courier-delivered signed hotfixes with operator acceptance steps.
nora: I'll schedule a 30m presales + eng call with HarvestCo for tomorrow 9am PT. Kevin/Sophie please bring a short runbook and sample manifest.
kevin: Will do, dropping SOW skeleton in RDW-9020 today.
sophie: I'll post a minimal sample manifest and verification steps in the ticket after lab sanity tests.
nora: Thanks team — I'll update the customer after our call. :white_check_mark:
